title: Mrs. Ilana Alouf: "Parashat Toledot"

chapters.title: The birth of Yaakov and Esav
chapters.about: Yitzhak and Rivka's prayer and the conflict in the womb

chapters.title: Sfat Emet on abundance
chapters.about: The meaning of ve'yiten and bringing Nachat Ruach to Hashem

claims: "She explores the Sfat Emet's insights on... the role of prayer" - The teacher discusses prayer in the context of Yitzhak and Rivka, but does not present Sfat Emet's insights on the role of prayer.

"the complex relationship between Yaakov and Esav as a model for the world's ultimate redemption" - The teacher discusses the relationship as a model for managing abundance and the role of Am Yisrael, but does not frame it as a model for the world's ultimate redemption.
summary: Mrs. Alouf discusses the events of Parashat Toledot, focusing on the birth of Yaakov and Esav and the transmission of the blessing from Yitzhak. She explores the Sfat Emet's insights on the nature of abundance, the role of prayer, and the complex relationship between Yaakov and Esav as a model for the world's ultimate redemption.
questions: Why did Rivka feel a conflict in her womb during pregnancy?
What is the significance of the double blessing 've'yiten' in Yitzhak's words?
Why did Yitzhak insist on digging the same wells as Avraham?
How does the story of Yaakov and Esav relate to the concept of the Bechor?
What is the role of Am Yisrael in bringing abundance to the world?
